resources.string: This command may wait for the running sync round. Uploading is not cancelled instantly.
This flavor is offline. Auth and RemoteStore are absent; local ledger and backups remain available.
Core limits: #62 builtin-category merge, #63 changes after lost acknowledgement, #70 interrupted first sync and account switching. The adapter does not fix these.
One Google UID per installation. Sign out retains the binding. Missing identity for an existing Core ledger blocks sync rather than guessing ownership.
The passphrase is never stored or sent. Core derives and verifies the key; syncing may begin after acceptance.
Core asks about a different ledger account. Cross-UID choices stay closed while #70 lacks a public ownership receipt. Continue offline or export a backup.
Cloud protocol is newer. Upgrade the app before sync or cloud reset.
A document written here blocks sync. Edit and save its local record or explicitly reset cloud sync.
A document written elsewhere blocks sync. Fix it on that device or explicitly reset cloud sync.
Forgot passphrase? Reset makes a Core safety backup, deletes cloud v2 data, and requires a new passphrase on other devices.
Both devices edited the same unit
Deleted elsewhere; these local records still reference it.
Legacy v1 is never imported into v2. Check or delete it only after all devices have upgraded.
Delete all cloud v2 data and recreate crypto? Core first writes a safety backup. Other devices need the new passphrase; local ledger remains.
Discard local sync data and replace from cloud? Core first saves a safety backup and renews device ID.
Confirm all devices upgraded. Delete v1 records/meta only; v2 and local ledger stay unchanged.
